purpose: Curated financing-program dataset used by Karobaar AI to compare verified merchant business evidence against published or manually checked financing requirements.
disclaimer: Karobaar AI does not approve loans, guarantee eligibility, perform underwriting, or generate a credit score. Program matches only indicate that recorded business evidence appears to satisfy selected requirements. Final eligibility is determined by the financing provider.

manual.description: A requirement that Karobaar AI cannot determine reliably from the merchant ledger and must be confirmed by the user or financing provider.

metric.description: A requirement that can be compared deterministically against a metric derived from verified Karobaar business records.

history_months.label: Recorded business history
history_months.description: Number of months of verified business activity recorded in Karobaar AI.

avg_monthly_sales_paisa.label: Average monthly sales
avg_monthly_sales_paisa.description: Average monthly verified sales calculated from the merchant ledger.

evidence_coverage_pct.label: Supporting evidence coverage
evidence_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of verified transactions that include supporting evidence such as receipts.

matching_logic.metric_requirement: For metric requirements, compare the merchant metric with the configured operator and threshold value.
matching_logic.manual_requirement: Manual requirements are never automatically marked as satisfied unless the merchant or an authorized verification process explicitly confirms them.

recommended_user_language.matched: Your recorded business data appears to meet this requirement.
recommended_user_language.missing: Your recorded business data currently appears below this requirement.
recommended_user_language.manual_check_required: This requirement needs to be confirmed manually.
recommended_user_language.insufficient_data: Karobaar does not yet have enough verified data to evaluate this requirement.

prohibited_claims: You are guaranteed to receive this loan.
